name: @onedigitas/kitcode
description: Local aggregate activity server for KitCode.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-integration-spec.mjs && node scripts/check-reward-summary.mjs && node scripts/check-source-snapshot.mjs && node scripts/check-project-ledger.mjs && node scripts/check-cli-commands.mjs && node scripts/check-terminal-window.mjs && node scripts/check-onboarding-window.mjs && node scripts/check-onboarding-projects.mjs && node scripts/check-pet-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-pet-window.mjs && node scripts/check-pet-motion.mjs && node scripts/check-pet-api.mjs && node --check bin/kitcode.mjs && for file in src/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done && for file in src/*.cjs; do node --check "$file"; done
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build && npm publish --access public
